name: BGP ASN Route & Path Visualizer
desc: Simulate, analyze, and visualize BGP Autonomous System (AS) routing topologies, AS-Path prepending, tier hierarchy, and loop detection entirely client-side. Zero telemetry.

name: IPv4/IPv6 Subnet & CIDR Calculator
desc: Calculate IPv4 and IPv6 network boundaries, broadcast addresses, usable host ranges, wildcard masks, and route properties entirely client-side.

name: Crontab Expression Tester & Schedule Validator
desc: Parse, validate, and simulate Unix crontab schedule expressions in local browser memory. Calculate human-readable descriptions and upcoming run executions. Zero tracking, zero network egress.

name: DMARC Record Generator & Policy Builder
desc: Generate, validate, and inspect RFC 7489 compliant DMARC TXT records client-side in browser memory. Configure policy alignment, aggregate reporting URIs, and forensic alerts offline. Zero tracking, zero network egress.

name: DNS Wire Format Hex Visualizer & Parser
desc: Encode, decode, and visually dissect binary RFC 1035 DNS wire-format packets, headers, flags, QNAME labels, and resource records in local browser memory. Zero tracking, zero network egress.

name: Docker Compose & Container Security Auditor
desc: Audit Docker Compose files, Dockerfiles, and container run manifests for privileged mode, root execution, unconfined capabilities, host socket mounts, and misconfigurations entirely client-side.

name: IP Address Converter & Notation Transformer
desc: Convert IPv4 and IPv6 addresses between decimal, hexadecimal, binary, octal, integer, compressed, expanded, and reverse DNS PTR notations in local browser memory. Zero tracking, zero network egress.

name: Nginx Configuration Linter & Security Auditor
desc: Lint, validate, and audit Nginx configuration files for syntax errors, missing semicolons, unbalanced braces, proxy_pass trailing slash pitfalls, alias traversal bugs, and TLS security misconfigurations locally.

name: SPF Record Deconstructor & Validator
desc: Deconstruct, parse, and validate Sender Policy Framework (RFC 7208) TXT records in local browser memory. Calculate DNS lookup limits, mechanism costs, and security qualifiers without network egress.

name: Syslog RFC 3164 & RFC 5424 Message Parser
desc: Parse, dissect, and validate RFC 3164 (BSD) and RFC 5424 (IETF) syslog records in local browser memory. Extract PRI, Facility, Severity, Structured Data, and message payloads with zero network egress.

name: User-Agent Parser & Client Hint Analyzer
desc: Parse, inspect, and analyze User-Agent strings, browser rendering engines, OS architectures, device profiles, and Client Hints locally in your browser memory. Zero tracking, zero network egress.
